amanda: Quick postmortem follow-up for DR: consolidating action items for regional failover, backups checks, and next game-day. Please ACK ownership here.

amanda: Top items I captured: 1) table-level restore steps missing from runbook, 2) DNS failover cadence + TTLs, 3) automated backup dry-restore job, 4) game-day checklist and comms.

raj: I'll take table-level restores. I'll add explicit SQL snippets, estimated timings, and a rollback note. Due: 1814630000.

devops-bot: last_backup_check: 1814500000 status=ok missing_incr=0

sasha: I'll own DNS failover cadence and canary percentages. Will add traffic-validation script and pre-failover capacity check. Due: 1814680000.

sec: Reminder: if dry-restores copy production data into staging, we need a scrub/masking step. Assign security review early.

amanda: Good catch @sec. We'll add a masking step before artifacts land in staging.

raj: small blocker 5 need CI credentials to run restore in pipeline. @sec can you grant short-lived creds to ci-runner?

sec: I'll grant scoped creds for the dry-restore job, will require PR with justification.

sasha: I'll also add a throttling knob to the routing policy to prevent flapping under load. Proposed default: stop failover if GPU utilization > 70% in target region.

amanda: All right. I've created the tracker doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/dr-followups-compact. Please comment to ACK and set due_ts. Planning a 90-minute mini game-day on 1814720000 to validate these changes. Volunteers?

raj: I'll participate and run DB ops.

sasha: I'll run routing and canary steps.

amanda: Thanks. Marking rows in tracker as "in progress". Reopen thread if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
